svg.text: Cat-like Oni: the pilot (main character) and three companions, 2–3 of which crew the carrier
ONI SPACEWAR · exploratory concept · not a decided art direction
Flies the battleship; triggers Q/W/E/R by hand
Fix / build / haul; auto-repair skill when HP low
Auto-fires damage skill when enemy in range
Silhouette variants — ear / tail / build are the main readable differences at gameplay scale
